issues.problem: Version 2.2 remains online but is a legacy API version. The current documented API root is v2.4, which is not backward-compatible with v2.2.
issues.suggestion: Use https://api.17track.net/track/v2.4 and the current documentation, or explicitly label this entry as the supported legacy v2.2 interface.

issues.problem: The response uses the old v1-style track.e event structure and is not consistent with the v2.2 gettrackinfo response schema, which uses track_info, latest_status, latest_event, and provider event structures.
issues.suggestion: Replace the snippet with an actual v2.2 response, or upgrade the request and response together to the official v2.4 gettrackinfo schema.

issues.problem: ABS changed the Data API root on 2024-11-29. https://api.data.abs.gov.au is the former root; the current REST root is https://data.api.abs.gov.au/rest.

The curl uses the retired host/path and an obsolete CPI 1.0.0 dataflow version. Old structure versions can be removed and return 404. The response snippet also reflects the older SDMX-JSON envelope rather than the current meta/data structure.
issues.suggestion: Rebuild the example using https://data.api.abs.gov.au/rest/data/ and a current dataflow such as CPI_Q for quarterly CPI, preferably omitting the version to select the latest; capture a fresh response from that request.

issues.problem: The rate limit is published rather than unknown. Abstract's current pricing page lists 3 requests/second for the free plan, although an older API error-code section still says 1 request/second.
issues.suggestion: Use the current plan/dashboard limit, presently 3 requests/second for the free plan, and optionally note the conflicting older documentation.

issues.problem: The free-tier limit is known: the current free plan includes 1,000 requests.
The free-plan rate limit is published as 1 request/second.
issues.suggestion: Set rate_limits to "Free plan: 1 request/second; paid limits vary by plan."

issues.problem: Current AccuWeather documentation requires the API key in an Authorization header using Bearer authentication, not the apikey query parameter shown here. The query form is the legacy interface.
issues.suggestion: Use "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" and describe query-parameter authentication as legacy if it is retained at all.

issues.problem: The stated historical approximately 50-calls/day limit is not the current Core Weather offer. Current trials last 14 days: Core Weather allows 500 requests/day and MinuteCast allows 50 requests/day. Paid packages now start at approximately $2/month rather than being exclusively contact-sales.
issues.suggestion: State that the free access is a 14-day trial with 500 Core Weather requests/day or 50 MinuteCast requests/day, followed by paid packages starting around $2/month.

issues.problem: The curl authenticates through the legacy apikey query parameter and is inconsistent with the current documented Bearer-header interface.
The value is a placeholder and no usable API root is supplied.
issues.suggestion: For the personal RapidAPI product use https://adsbexchange-com1.p.rapidapi.com; for contracted direct access use the separately documented https://gateway.adsbexchange.com/api/aircraft/v2 root. Do not combine the two interfaces.

issues.problem: The entry conflates RapidAPI personal access with direct enterprise/data-program access. They use different hosts and headers.
issues.suggestion: For RapidAPI specify X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host. For direct gateway access specify the provider-issued api-auth or currently documented direct API-key header and describe it as a separate commercial product.

issues.problem: free_tier is true even though the current public personal API is a paid RapidAPI subscription advertised at $10/month for 10,000 requests. Enterprise and historical access are separate quoted products.
issues.suggestion: Set free_tier to false, free_tier_limits to "no public free tier", and paid_plans to "$10/month for 10,000 personal-use requests via RapidAPI; contact sales for enterprise, commercial, historical, or enriched access."

issues.problem: The field is an unresolved placeholder.
issues.suggestion: Record the 10,000-request monthly plan quota and verify the current RapidAPI dashboard for any separate per-second throttling before publishing.

issues.problem: Both request and response are unresolved placeholders, so the entry contains no usable or verifiable example.
issues.suggestion: Add a real example for one selected product, such as a RapidAPI ICAO lookup with both required RapidAPI headers, and capture its actual ac-array response.

issues.problem: The official service is the Advice Slip JSON API and documents JSON/JSONP responses plus a separate RSS feed; it does not document general XML responses.
issues.suggestion: Replace "Responses are available in JSON or XML" with "Responses are available in JSON or JSONP; a separate daily RSS feed is also available."

issues.problem: The URL is a valid Checkout test host, but the entry is presented as a root for the general Adyen platform and describes Management APIs as well. Management APIs use other hosts, while live Checkout URLs are account-prefixed.
issues.suggestion: Rename/scope the entry to "Adyen Checkout API (test)" or document the separate API-family roots and account-specific live Checkout URL format.

issues.problem: "Contact sales for rates" overlooks Adyen's published region- and payment-method-specific transaction fees. Contacting sales is mainly needed for custom terms and the applicable minimum invoice.
issues.suggestion: Describe pricing as a fixed processing fee plus the published payment-method fee, with region-specific rates and a possible minimum invoice; reserve "contact sales" for custom pricing.
